_meta_itemized.notes: Corrie Forsling, County Treasurer, 2020 Post-Election - the whole campaign is one self-funded contribution paying one county filing fee, netting to zero. Typed on the 2020 blank form, clean scan, faithful OCR layer, but noticeably skewed (the page was fed at an angle; both sheets show the scanner's black edge band at the foot). SOURCE PROPERTY: unlike every other 2020 filing in this chunk, NO template specimen row survives on either page - this filer TYPED OVER the specimen line rather than striking it or leaving it, so the specimen-drop rule has nothing to do here and the printed totals close on the first read. (Across the six filings of this chunk the specimen has now been seen in all three states: typed over here, struck with a pen on 11859/12942, struck with heavy black marker on 12944, and left in place unstruck on 11863.) Privacy: the contribution row carries a street address; discarded at read time, only city/state ('Park City', 'UT') recorded. FILER INCONSISTENCY worth noting and NOT repaired: the row pairs a Park City mailing address with zip 84017, which is Coalville's zip, not Park City's - the city is recorded as the filer printed it and no city was inferred from the zip. The donor is the candidate and her spouse jointly ('Corrie & Scott Forsling'), kept verbatim as one donor string. No in-kind schedule, no redactions.
